paragraphs.text: You stare out the window and watch as the sun reaches the horizon, bathing the village in sickly orange. It has been a long night and you feel stiff and irritable. You rub your eyes.
A few minutes later, you hear May bustling in the kitchen. Then the front door opens and closes.
Make a CON roll. If you fail, your skill rolls today suffer a penalty. Roll the “tens” percentage die twice and take the higher result. This does not apply to Luck, Sanity or damage rolls.
